about.heading: Travel, with a little more you.
about.body: Travel with Ease is Accra's boutique travel planning agency for people who want to travel well without the burden of planning. Whether it's your first trip abroad or your fifteenth, we handle the flights, hotels, itineraries and support, so you don't have to. First-timers get a patient guide. Busy travellers get their time back.

entries.heading: Founded in 2026 by Nana Abena Osei-Wusu
entries.text: I grew up travelling every year, thanks to my parents. As I got older, the roles reversed: I was the one filling in passport and visa forms, booking flights and hotels, and planning trips for my parents and me. Then I started exploring on my own. Without realising it, I was always researching and planning great trips, and I never thought of it as a business. I love planning, and I love structure. I wanted to build something alongside my career, and when I put my ideas down, everything came back to travel.

faqs.heading: A few things worth knowing.
faqs.body: Clear answers before you start planning.

entries.heading: How do I start planning a trip?
entries.text: Use the enquiry form to share your destination ideas, dates, traveller count and budget. We discuss your plans and confirm the appropriate service or a live package quote.

entries.heading: Do package prices include flights?
entries.text: Published starting prices are per person sharing a room and include return flights from Accra. Your dates, hotel availability, live airfare and exchange rate determine the final quote.

entries.heading: What is included in a Travel Readiness Session?
entries.text: A 40-minute advisory call covering destination advice, flight routing, a visa overview and a realistic budget. The GHS 400 session is advice only and does not include bookings.

entries.heading: How do package deposits work?
entries.text: A GHS 5,000 deposit per person confirms a package booking. It is non-refundable if you withdraw. The balance is due on the date in your quote, normally 45–70 days before departure.

entries.heading: Can I travel without sharing a room?
entries.text: Yes. A single supplement applies when you do not share a room. Message us for your exact price.

entries.heading: Does sending an enquiry confirm a booking?
entries.text: No. An enquiry starts a conversation. Your live quote, agreed terms and cleared payment are separate steps. There is no online checkout on this website.

articles.title: Six days on Zanzibar’s north coast
articles.excerpt: Dolphins by morning, dhow at sunset, a lively north coast in between.
articles.body:
Five nights on Zanzibar's north coast with return flights, transfers, three signature tours and both insurances taken care of. Pick your dates and your level of comfort, and we plan the rest.

Day 1 — Arrive on the north coast
Meet your airport transfer and settle into your north coast beach hotel.

Day 2 — Mnemba Island
Snorkel the reef, look out for dolphins, visit the sandbank and enjoy lunch.

Day 3 — Prison Island and Stone Town
See the giant tortoises and explore Stone Town's alleys and markets with a guide.

Day 4 — Beach time and a dhow sunset
A free beach day followed by a sunset dhow trip.

Day 5 — Your own pace
Enjoy a free day, with an optional spice farm visit at extra cost.

Day 6 — Homeward
Breakfast, your airport transfer and the flight home.

A single supplement applies when you do not share a room. Message us for your exact price.

privacy.heading: Privacy notice
privacy.body: Travel With Ease uses your information to respond to enquiries, provide the travel services you request and operate this website.

entries.heading: Who handles your information
entries.text: Travel With Ease, a trading name of TWE Concierge, is based in Accra, Ghana. Contact nana@travelwitheasegh.com or +233 20 020 9170 with questions about your information.

entries.heading: Information you provide
entries.text: The enquiry form collects your name, email, WhatsApp number, enquiry type, requested service, destination, travel timeframe, number of travellers, optional budget and notes, and your permission to respond. Do not enter passport numbers, payment details, medical records or other unnecessary sensitive information.

entries.heading: Operational and security information
entries.text: We store your enquiry reference, submission and notice timestamps, source, delivery status and the staff actions needed to manage your request. Hosting and security providers can process IP addresses, browser/request metadata and security events. Cookie preferences are stored in your browser.

entries.heading: Why we use it
entries.text: We use your details to assess your request, contact you, prepare agreed travel services and protect the service. Enquiry consent is not marketing consent. Where processing relies on consent, you can withdraw it by contacting us; withdrawal does not undo processing already carried out.

entries.heading: Analytics and search
entries.text: Optional Google Analytics is blocked until you allow analytics cookies and remains subject to browser privacy signals. It measures public website usage, not enquiry answers or private staff activity. Google Search Console provides search-performance information separately from the analytics tag.

entries.heading: Providers and communications
entries.text: Cloudflare and Railway provide hosting, storage or security; Resend handles operational email; Google supports optional analytics, search reporting and approved media-source operations. Production enquiry acknowledgements copy notifications@travelwitheasegh.com so the team can respond. WhatsApp, Instagram and TikTok links open third-party services with their own terms. Provider processing can take place outside Ghana.

entries.heading: Retention and access
entries.text: We keep information for handling your enquiry, agreed services and applicable legal or dispute requirements. Authorised staff access is restricted by role. Contact us about retention or deletion; some records may need to be kept where an applicable obligation requires it.

entries.heading: Your choices and rights
entries.text: You can contact us to request access, correction, deletion where applicable, raise an objection or withdraw consent. We may need proportionate identity verification. You can also contact Ghana’s Data Protection Commission at https://dpc.gov.gh about your rights under the Data Protection Act, 2012 (Act 843).

entries.heading: Effective date
entries.text: 1 November 2026. Material changes to this notice will be reflected here.

privacy.seoDescription: Travel With Ease uses your information to respond to enquiries, provide the travel services you request and operate this website.

terms.heading: Booking and planning terms
terms.body: Read these terms alongside your live quote before making a payment.

entries.heading: Planning services and payment
entries.text: Complete the intake and pay 50% of the planning fee, or 60% for group planning, to begin. We confirm the start date by WhatsApp. The balance is due before the final travel pack is delivered.

entries.heading: Your Travel Fund
entries.text: Travel costs are separate from the planning fee. We send a Travel Fund Request for the exact booking costs and book only when funds have cleared. We do not advance booking costs. Foreign-currency estimates include a 5% buffer; any unused buffer is refunded.

entries.heading: Revisions and scope
entries.text: Full Trip Planning includes one minor revision; further minor revisions cost GHS 150 each. Premium includes unlimited minor revisions. A new destination or full itinerary restructure is a new scope. Planning fees are fixed.

entries.heading: Group changes
entries.text: Group changes cost GHS 100–150; date changes cost GHS 150. Supplier cancellation terms and actual cancellation costs also apply.

entries.heading: Package prices
entries.text: Published "from" prices are indicative, per person sharing a room, and include return flights from Accra. They are based on our reference month. Your final price depends on your travel dates, hotel availability, live airfare and the exchange rate. We send you a live quote before you pay a deposit. If your balance is due months after booking, it is recalculated at the exchange rate on your final payment date.

entries.heading: Package deposits and balances
entries.text: A GHS 5,000 deposit per person confirms your package booking and locks the quoted rate, subject to the exchange-rate provision above for a later balance. This deposit is non-refundable if you withdraw. The balance is due on the date in your quote, normally 45–70 days before departure depending on the hotel. Bookings are made only after funds have cleared. Payment is available through Telecel Cash or MTN MoMo; payment instructions are provided privately.

entries.heading: Insurance and travel documents
entries.text: Packages include the insurance specified in their inclusions. You remain responsible for your passport, visas and entry requirements; advice is not a visa guarantee. For planning-only services, travel insurance is recommended. Entry and insurance rules can change, so confirm the current requirements before travel.

entries.heading: Room sharing
entries.text: A single supplement applies when you do not share a room. Message us for your exact price.

entries.heading: Display currency and indicative exchange rates
entries.text: The website currency selector changes display estimates only. Package and service prices are published in Ghanaian cedi (GHS); original GHS amounts remain alongside conversions. Reference rates are supplied by ExchangeRate-API and cached, so conversions are approximate, not a live quote, bank rate, payment-currency choice or price guarantee. The selector's accessible status and tooltip identify the rate date and any cached fallback. Rates over 72 hours old are not used; if a rate is unavailable or expires, the website shows GHS. Changing display currency does not change your quote, booking terms, payment schedule, or the separate Travel Fund exchange-rate provisions above. Your successful currency preference is stored on this browser under twe-display-currency-v1; clearing browser storage resets it. Currency switching requires JavaScript, but original GHS prices remain available without it.
